text:
Ibrahim Khan: hey folks, Ibrahim here starting today (ML infra). I'm blocked on cloud access: need GCP project for private perf runs in europe-west2 and the right IAM roles. The new-hire form only lets me pick a global project, which won't satisfy data residency. any pointers?

infra-bot: SSO active for ibrahim.k@redwood.ai. Please follow onboarding checklist: https://onboard.redwood.ai.

Nina Ortiz: welcome! the reserved project is `redwood-private-eu-ml`. You should request `roles/storage.admin` for the dataset bucket, `roles/compute.viewer` to see instances, and `roles/ml-engine.admin` if you submit jobs. If you need a service account for CI, ask for `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` on `projects/PROJECT_ID/serviceAccounts/sa-ml@redwood.gserviceaccount.com`.

Ibrahim Khan: thanks Nina. the form doesn't accept service account ARNs. should I paste the full resource name in the description field?

Priya Rao: yes paste the full resource name and project number. Also include the required org policy exception: allow `europe-west2` for `compute.googleapis.com` - we have a per-team whitelist. infra will approve if you include justification.

Ibrahim Khan: got project number `234567890123`. Requesting storage.admin + compute.viewer + ml-engine.admin, and serviceAccountUser on sa-ml. Justification: running latency-sensitive private perf tests for Redwood Optimize evals.

Nina Ortiz: filed internal ticket INFRA-7599 to attach billing and service account roles. Should be ~same-day. If org policy blocks region I'll escalate.

Ibrahim Khan: perfect, appreciate it. also, any preferred bucket naming for private data?

Priya Rao: use `redwood-private-<team>-eu-<env>` and include `data_class=private` tag. Infra will enforce encryption and retention.

Ibrahim Khan: thanks all, excited to be here :wave:
